newsitem.title: USA: Orion Capital to issue $125 mln securities.
newsitem.headline: Orion Capital to issue $125 mln securities.

text.p: Orion Capital Corp said Wednesday it had agreed to sell $125 million in 8.73-percent capital securities.
Orion Capital Trust I, a Delaware statutory business trust sponsored by Orion, will issue the securities, it said.
The company said the securities might be redeemed without premium on January 1, 2007.
It said it intended to use the proceeds for "general corporate purposes, which may include investments in and advances to subsidiaries and the financing of growth and expansion."
